newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Watchdog says no approach yet on Johnnic.
newsitem.headline: Watchdog says no approach yet on Johnnic.

text.p: South Africa's Securities Regulation Panel said on Thursday it had yet to be approached regarding the National Empowerment Consortium's (NEC) purchase of a stake in Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd (Johnnic).
Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell the bulk of its 47.4 percent stake in Johnnic to the NEC, at a discount.
The deal is conditional on SRP approval that the NEC will not have to make a comparable offer to other Johnnic shareholders should it acquire a stake of 35 percent or more.

"The Panel has not yet been approached informally or formally for a ruling...When such an application is received it will be dealt with in accordance with the provisions of the Companies Act No.61 of 1973 and the Rules of the Panel," the SRP said.
